description: Consent in publisher mode (the default). Global Privacy Control denies storage. A TC string needs publisher consent (the publisher TC segment) for Purpose 1 and at least one of Purposes 2-10, even with gdpr=0. When GDPR applies, no TC string denies storage. Denied requests delete existing ID cookies. TC strings: CAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA.eAAAAAAAAA has publisher consent for purposes 1-2; ….cAAAAAAAAA for purpose 1 only; ….aAAAAAAAAA for purpose 2 only; CAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAPAAAAAAAAAAAAA has vendor consent for purposes 1-4 and no publisher segment.
